# Article VII Basketball Related Income and Apron Levels

<!-- pdf-page: 210 -->

## Section 2(e) Operation of Apron Levels

A second-apron team cannot aggregate salaries in a trade.

<!-- pdf-page: 215 -->

Cash in a trade is also restricted. This whole section stays one chunk.

## Section 6(f) Taxpayer Mid-Level Salary Exception

<!-- pdf-page: 261 -->

The taxpayer mid-level exception is separate from the apron table.

### (1) Amount

The amount is five million dollars in 2023-24 and this sentence is long enough to cross a tiny budget when tests ask for a split.

<!-- pdf-page: 262 -->

### (2) Limit

A team may not use the exception when the signing would cross the second apron.
